name: Odoo
description: Shows Odoo task links as live cards. Built for chat.unstaticlabs.com; the Odoo side is the usl_mattermost module in the same repository.

settings_schema.header: Shows Odoo task links as cards. The keys come from rotator; see the repository README and docs/api.md.

settings.help_text: The Odoo base URL. Task links on its host get cards, and the plugin calls the usl_mattermost API there.
Signs the plugin's requests to Odoo. The same value is in Odoo's key file usl_mattermost_plugin_key. At least 32 characters.
Checks Odoo's "task changed" requests. The same value is in Odoo's key file usl_mattermost_webhook_key. At least 32 characters.
Also accepted during a key rotation. Leave empty otherwise.
